description: Borrow invariant learning from IC3/PDR, but only as an attachment to a changed decomposition or obstruction object. Learned invariants must block orbit families of partial colorings and remain certificate-carrying.
mathematical_formalization: Learn invariant clauses I such that I is inductive over a quotient state graph Q of partial colorings and each I_k is checkable and transferable across symmetry conventions.
implementation_hypothesis: Start from H1 or H2 branch families and test whether learned kernels survive held-out branches and symmetry choices.
experiment_seed: On a verified ladder rung, compare proof bytes with and without invariant reuse on disjoint branch families.

closest_prior_art.title: Decreasing the upper bound on the Ramsey number R(5,5)

novelty_claim: The invariant is valuable only if it becomes a reusable forbidden-partial-coloring lemma.
differentiation: A stronger SAT engine on the same decomposition does not count.
